title: The Mughals Laying of Seige Around (Banda Singh)

blocks.text: Some of Banda’s Sikhs relay these proposals back to him and begin acting as though the arrangement might be workable, while food and money continue to pass in under the tightening ring.
The page stresses that the danger now lies not only outside the camp but among Banda’s Sikhs, whose wavering helps make the encirclement effective.
Banda’s Sikhs are the central anchor because internal softness now matters as much as enemy force.
